author: sjm41
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**
Sterile alpha and TIR motif-containing protein 1 InterPro entry (IPR039184)

* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Dmel Sarm (Q6IDD9)


* **Description of issue**
IPR039184 is currently annotated with [NAD+ nucleosidase activity (GO:0003953)](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/GTerm?id=GO:0003953), which is mapped to EC:3.2.2.5, which describes a bacterial activity that "catalyzes the hydrolysis of NAD(+), without associated ADP-ribosyl cyclase activity (unlike the metazoan enzyme EC:3.2.2.6, bifunctional ADP-ribosyl cyclase/cyclic ADP-ribose hydrolase)."

IPR039184 also has the EC xref 3.2.2.6.

3.2.2.6 is correct, meaning the associated GO term should be changed to the related term GO:0061809 NAD+ nucleosidase activity, cyclic ADP-ribose generating (that itself has xref EC: 3.2.2.6
title: InterPro2GO issue: Sterile alpha and TIR motif-containing protein 1 InterPro entry (IPR039184)

author: nicoleamorveli
body:
Hi Steven,
Thank you for flagging this. You're correct, [IPR039184](http://pronto.ebi.ac.uk:5000/entry/IPR039184/?) should be annotated with GO:0061809 (NAD+ nucleosidase activity, cyclic ADP-ribose generating) rather than GO:0003953.
I have replaced the term in the entry; the changes will be visible in the next InterPro release (110.0).
Best,
Nicole
